breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible perforated strip is switched to a displacement-only formulation on the claim that the hole removes locking
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a mixed displacement-pressure formulation (Taylor-Hood elements with CG2 for displacement and CG1 for pressure) rather than a displacement-only element pair. It explicitly states 'The formulation is a mixed displacement-pressure approach,' directly contradicting the incorrect claim in the incomplete prompt that a displacement-only element is sufficient due to the hole relieving volumetric locking. This aligns with the ground truth which mandates a mixed formulation because ν is close to 0.5.
